mainEntity.name: What should I do first if my cabin interior feels drafty or I can see gaps inside?

acceptedAnswer.text: The fastest first step is to identify where air or moisture is getting in, then seal the biggest gaps before adding finish materials. In Denver-area homes and cabins, that usually means checking joints around windows, doors, trim, plumbing penetrations, and rim areas first.
acceptedAnswer.description: Start by finding the biggest gaps around windows, doors, trim, and utility penetrations, then seal those before doing cosmetic work. In cabins around Denver, the most noticeable leaks are often the easiest and highest-value places to address first.
